newsitem.title: USA: Creative Programming may face delisting.
newsitem.headline: Creative Programming may face delisting.

text.p: Creative Programming & Technology Ventures Inc said Wednesday it will attend a hearing Thursday by the National Association of Securities Dealers to consider NASD's proposed delisting of its stock.
The company said it has had this matter under review and has submitted a response to contest the move.
"We will use our best efforts to protect the interests of CPTV and its shareholders, and to retain our Nasdaq SmallCap Market listing," a company statement said.
Creative Programming said if the panel does not accept its position, delisting could occur within a short period thereafter.
It said it is in compliance with all financial criteria for continued listing and has advised NASD that it is negotiating to acquire a new business.
"Precedents clearly dictate that CPTV be given a reasonable period of time to redeploy its liquid assets," the company statement said.
